observations.name: Mobile reset clears separate project draft

notes: Actual browser navigation, two synthetic profiles, two projects and both planning kinds.
Synthetic JSON responses; no ChatGPT request sent. Story file selected through actual file chooser.
Story imported first. Requirement response then rejected as stale; its synthetic version was updated from the newly generated visible request before re-review and import.
Request copy button exercised only to generate story request; clipboard contents not independently verified.
Explicitly cleared leftover temporary drafts in other profile and project.
No forced delayed import/file-read race in browser; stale-completion helper tested separately.
